name: Driver Display
author: Sedz
description:
A full HUD on the steering wheel display. Can be used in cockpit view as a replacement to the game's on-screen one, or outside cockpit view as just an immersive texture replacer.

It contains three pages (race, car damage, and pit information), switched by a button you assign. Flags, safety cars, warnings, and penalties will pop up on screen. Fully compatible with SimHub and other UDP telemetry mods.

Needs Swofty Launcher 1.10.41 or newer. Tested on the Steam copy of the game; the EA app copy gets the data the display needs from launcher 1.10.41 on, but hasn't been tested yet.

options.label: Delta against
options.description: What the live delta compares your lap with: the previous lap or your best lap of the session.

options.label: Flag screen
options.description: Flags (red flag, safety car, VSC, yellow, blue) fill the whole screen: briefly when they come out (4 s, then a blinking strip along the top and bottom edges), or for as long as they are out.

options.label: Page button (UDP Action)
options.description: Bind a button (wheel, controller or keyboard) to this "UDP Action" in the game's Controls menu: it steps through the race, car and pit pages. 0 turns it off. Needs the game's UDP telemetry on.

options.label: Real-driver rev lights for created drivers
Tyre wear amber from (%)
options.description: Tyre wear from this shows amber.

options.label: Tyre wear red from (%)
options.description: Tyre wear from this shows red.

options.label: Team pages speed unit
options.description: The speed on the team pages (Ferrari, McLaren, Mercedes, Red Bull, Aston Martin, Williams, Audi, Haas and Alpine, 2025 and 2026 cars): KPH or MPH.

options.label: Debug log
options.description: Write the HUD's lap timing and values to swofty/loader.log every 10 seconds.
